evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we introduce NaijaHate, the first dataset annotated for HSD which contains a representative sample of Nigerian tweets.
We then propose NaijaXLM-T, a pretrained model tailored to the Nigerian Twitter context, and establish the key role played by domain-adaptive pretraining and finetuning in maximizing HSD performance.
